cd /workspace && python3 -c "
import zipfile,re
z=zipfile.ZipFile('output/offer_letter_filled.docx')
parts=[n for n in z.namelist() if re.match(r'word/(document|header\d+|footer\d+)\.xml\$',n) or re.match(r'word/(document|header\d+|footer\d+)\.xml',n)]
leftover=0
for n in parts:
    d=z.read(n).decode('utf-8')
    txt=re.sub(r'<[^>]+>','',d)
    bad=re.findall(r'\{\{[^}]*\}\}|[A-Z][A-Z_]{3,}',txt)
    bad=[b for b in bad if b not in ('USD',)]
    if bad:
        leftover+=1
        print(n, bad)
print('leftover parts:', leftover)
print('--- document body text ---')
d=z.read('word/document.xml').decode('utf-8')
for m in re.finditer(r'<w:t[^>]*>(.*?)</w:t>',d,re.S):
    t=m.group(1)
    if t.strip(): print(repr(t))
"
